facts.text: The resort overlooks Grikos Bay on the island of Patmos.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the serene shores of Patmos island, Patmos Aktis Resort & Spa is a sanctuary of refined luxury and natural beauty. Overlooking the azure waters of Grikos Bay

facts.text: The beach in front of the resort is on the southeast side of Patmos in Grikos Bay, framed by rock formations.
facts.excerpt: the beach in front of Patmos Aktis is nestled on the southeast side of the sacred Patmos Island in Grikos Bay. Framed by mesmerizing rock formations and serene, marine life-rich waters

facts.text: Kalikatsou Rock reflects its shape on the waters of Grikos Bay.
facts.excerpt: The reputable Kalikatsou Rock, reflects its shape on the bay's waters.

facts.text: The beach offers sunbeds, beach towels and umbrellas, with shade under trees.
facts.excerpt: With sunbeds, beach towels, and umbrellas, guests can unwind in style under the shade of trees.

facts.text: The Aegean Beach Front Suite with Private Pool has a private pool and terrace with views of the island's landmarks.
